---
title: "NT Conductivity QAQC"
author: "Julian Gan"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE)
library(here)

ysi_data <- read.csv(here("NT_YSI_waterchemistry_20251028.csv"))

# Need to import baro data from 2024-2025 and name baro_dat_2425
baro_dat_2425 <- ...
```

```{r define-out-dir}
out_dir <- here("conductivity")
```

```{r bind-co-files}
co_bound <- bind_hobo_files(path_to_raw_folder = here("conductivity", "raw-data"),
                            path_to_output_folder = out_dir,
                            logger_type = "conductivity_U24",
                            metadata = deploy_metadat)
```

```{r add-baro-data}
co_dat_24 <- get_logger_data(path_to_data = paste0(out_dir, "/2024/processed"),
                          logger_type = "conductivity_U24",
                          data_processing = "v0.1")

co_dat_25 <- get_logger_data(path_to_data = paste0(out_dir, "/2025/processed"),
                          logger_type = "conductivity_U24",
                          data_processing = "v0.1")

co_dat <- bind_rows(co_dat_24, co_dat_25) %>% 
  mutate(timestamp = round_date(timestamp, unit = "hour"))
  
co_baro <- add_nearest_baro(input_data = co_dat,
                            input_logger_type = "conductivity_U24",
                            baro_data = baro_dat_2425,
                            path_to_output_folder = out_dir,
                            metadata = site_metadat)
```

# DARL_ST_30
## 1. Run qaqc
```{r}
stn_co_qaqc <- conductivity_qaqc(co_baro,
                                 var_airtemp_C = "airtemp_C_U20_adj",
                                 select_station = "DARL_ST_30")

stn_co_qaqc[[2]]
```

- 04/09/2025 might signal when the stilling well was knocked from its rock anchor and the CO logger was washed downstream, ending up on the bankside

## 2. Perform adjustments

- remove period between download of old logger and installation of new logger
```{r}
stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(stn_co_qaqc[[1]],
                               select_station = "DARL_ST_30",
                               logger_to_adjust = "conductivity_U24",
                               reason_to_adjust = "dry",
                               timestamp_start = "2025-06-03 10:00:00",
                               timestamp_end = "2025-06-04 17:00:00",
                               var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24",
                               var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24")
```

- remove period when logger was likely out of water due to being knocked out from stilling well
```{r}
stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(stn_co_qaqc[[1]],
                               select_station = "DARL_ST_30",
                               logger_to_adjust = "conductivity_U24",
                               reason_to_adjust = "disturbance",
                               timestamp_start = "2025-04-09 10:00:00",
                               timestamp_end = "2025-04-12 01:00:00",
                               var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24",
                               var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24")
```

## 3. Run drift-cal
```{r}
stn_co_dc <- correct_drift(stn_co_adj,
                           ref_data = ysi_dat,
                           select_station = "DARL_ST_30",
                           var_ref_timestamp = "timestamp",
                           var_ref_conduct_uScm = "cond_uscm_ysi",
                           var_ref_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_ysi")
```

## 4. Convert to Sp.C
```{r}
stn_spc <- conduct_temp_comp(stn_co_dc[[1]],
                             var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24_adj_dc",
                             var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24_adj_dc")
```

## 5. Write clean data
```{r}
write_clean_data(input_data = stn_spc,
                 path_to_output_folder = out_dir,
                 logger_type = "conductivity_U24")
```

# NTMS_ST_30
## 1. Run qaqc
```{r}
stn_co_qaqc <- conductivity_qaqc(co_baro,
                                 var_airtemp_C = "airtemp_C_U20_adj",
                                 select_station = "NTMS_ST_30")

stn_co_qaqc[[2]]
```

## 2. Perform adjustments
```{r}
# remove periods of ice
stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(stn_co_qaqc[[1]],
                               select_station = "NTMS_ST_30",
                               logger_to_adjust = "conductivity_U24",
                               reason_to_adjust = "ice",
                               timestamp_start = "2025-01-18 14:00:00",
                               timestamp_end = "2025-01-21 12:00:00",
                               var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24",
                               var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24")

stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(stn_co_adj,
                               select_station = "NTMS_ST_30",
                               logger_to_adjust = "conductivity_U24",
                               reason_to_adjust = "ice",
                               timestamp_start = "2025-02-03 04:00:00",
                               timestamp_end = "2025-02-08 15:00:00",
                               var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24",
                               var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24")

# remove period when logger was likely out of water dry/ice
stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(stn_co_adj,
                               select_station = "NTMS_ST_30",
                               logger_to_adjust = "conductivity_U24",
                               reason_to_adjust = "dry",
                               timestamp_start = "2025-03-17 07:00:00",
                               timestamp_end = "2025-03-24 21:00:00",
                               var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24",
                               var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24")
```

## 3. Run drift-cal
```{r}
# no YSI measurements taken in 2025
stn_co_dc <- correct_drift(stn_co_adj,
                           ref_data = ysi_dat,
                           select_station = "NTMS_ST_30",
                           var_ref_timestamp = "timestamp",
                           var_ref_conduct_uScm = "cond_uscm_ysi",
                           var_ref_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_ysi")
```

## 4. Convert to Sp.C
```{r}
stn_spc <- conduct_temp_comp(stn_co_dc[[1]],
                             var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24_adj_dc",
                             var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24_adj_dc")
```

## 5. Write clean data
```{r}
write_clean_data(input_data = stn_spc,
                 path_to_output_folder = out_dir,
                 logger_type = "conductivity_U24")
```

# COOK_WE_40
## 1. Run qaqc

- Get water level data to aid with qaqc
```{r get-wl-data}
cook_wl <- get_logger_data(path_to_data = here("data", "water-level", "WE", "2025", "clean"),
                           logger_type = "waterlevel_U20",
                           data_processing = "clean",
                           select_station = "COOK_WE_40") %>% 
  select(timestamp, waterlevel_m_U20_adj, watertemp_C_U20_adj, starts_with("wl_qaqc"))

cook_at_wl <- co_baro %>% 
  filter(site_station_code == "COOK_WE_40") %>% 
  left_join(cook_wl, by = "timestamp")
```

```{r}
stn_co_qaqc <- conductivity_qaqc(cook_at_wl,
                                 var_airtemp_C = "airtemp_C_U20_adj",
                                 var_waterlevel_m = "waterlevel_m_U20_adj",
                                 var_watertemp_C_2 = "watertemp_C_U20_adj",
                                 select_station = "COOK_WE_40")
stn_co_qaqc[[2]]
```

## 2. Perform adjustments

- remove dry period from 2025-10-12 16:00
```{r}
stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(stn_co_qaqc[[1]][-(1:4),],
                               select_station = "COOK_WE_40",
                               timestamp_start = "2025-10-12 16:00:00",
                               timestamp_end = "2025-10-21 17:00:00",
                               reason_to_adjust = "dry",
                               logger_to_adjust = "conductivity_U24")
```

## 3. Run drift-cal
```{r}
stn_co_dc <- correct_drift(stn_co_adj,
                           ref_data = ysi_dat,
                           select_station = "COOK_WE_40",
                           var_ref_timestamp = "timestamp",
                           var_ref_conduct_uScm = "cond_uscm_ysi",
                           var_ref_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_ysi")
stn_co_dc[[3]]
stn_co_dc[[2]]
view(stn_co_dc[[1]])
stn_co_dc[[4]]
```

The two applicable YSI conductivity measurements are pretty far off from logger measurements; skip drift correction.

## 4. Convert to Sp.C
```{r}
stn_spc <- conduct_temp_comp(stn_co_adj)
```

## 5. Write clean data
```{r}
write_clean_data(input_data = stn_spc,
                 path_to_output_folder = out_dir,
                 logger_type = "conductivity_U24")
```

# MILE_WE_40
## 1. Run qaqc
```{r}
stn_co_qaqc <- conductivity_qaqc(co_baro,
                                 var_airtemp_C = "airtemp_C_U20_adj",
                                 select_station = "MILE_WE_40")
stn_co_qaqc[[2]]
```

## 2. Perform adjustments
- remove dry period from 08-12 10:00 to 08-13 12:00
```{r}
stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(input_data = stn_co_adj,
                               select_station = "MILE_WE_40",
                               var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24",

                               timestamp_end = "2025-08-13 01:00:00",
                               logger_to_adjust = "conductivity_U24",
                               reason_to_adjust = "dry")
```

- remove dry period from 2025-08-27 09:00 to 2025-09-17 12:00
```{r}
stn_co_adj <- adjust_logger_NA(input_data = stn_co_qaqc[[1]],
                               select_station = "MILE_WE_40",
                               var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24",
```

```{r}
stn_co_dc <- correct_drift(stn_co_adj,

stn_co_dc[[3]]
stn_co_dc[[2]]

# looks good
```


## 5. Write clean data

# TUMT_WE_40
## 1. Run qaqc
```{r}
stn_co_qaqc <- conductivity_qaqc(co_baro,
                                 var_airtemp_C = "airtemp_C_U20_adj",
                                 select_station = "TUMT_WE_40")
stn_co_qaqc[[2]]
```

## 2. Perform adjustments
```{r}
# Drop last row because logger recorded out of water
stn_co_adj <- stn_co_qaqc[[1]][-nrow(stn_co_qaqc[[1]]),]

# Add in rows for gap in logger install so ggplot doesn't connect data
stn_co_adj <- stn_co_adj %>%
  complete(timestamp = seq(min(timestamp), max(timestamp), by = "1 hour")) %>% 
  mutate(site_station_code = "TUMT_WE_40",
         co_qaqc_code = case_when(is.na(conduct_uScm_U24) ~ "LOGGER_REMOVED",
                                   TRUE ~ as.character(co_qaqc_code))
  )

conductivity_qaqc(stn_co_adj,var_airtemp_C = "airtemp_C_U20_adj",select_station = "TUMT_WE_40",plot_only=TRUE)
```

## 3. Run drift-cal
```{r}
ysi_dat2 <- ysi_dat %>% 
  filter(site_station_code == "TUMT_WE_40" & timestamp > "2025-04-15 00:00")

# Last ref measurement outside of logger data range due to last row being dropped
ysi_dat2$timestamp[3] <- ymd_hms("2025-10-23 09:00:00")

stn_co_dc <- correct_drift(stn_co_adj,
                           ref_data = ysi_dat2,
                           select_station = "TUMT_WE_40",
                           var_ref_timestamp = "timestamp",
                           var_ref_conduct_uScm = "cond_uscm_ysi",
                           var_ref_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_ysi")

stn_co_dc[[3]]
stn_co_dc[[2]]
```

## 4. Convert to Sp.C
```{r}
stn_spc <- conduct_temp_comp(stn_co_dc[[1]],
                             var_conduct_uScm = "conduct_uScm_U24_adj_dc",
                             var_watertemp_C = "watertemp_C_U24_adj_dc")
```

## 5. Write clean data
```{r}
write_clean_data(input_data = stn_spc,
                 path_to_output_folder = out_dir,
                 logger_type = "conductivity_U24")
```
